info.name: ResearchNexus — NUCES Research Portal API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the University Research Opportunity Portal.
Backend runs on http://localhost:5000

Assignment #01 — BS CS 5B — Fall 2026 — NUCES Peshawar

request.description: Verify that the API server is running and reachable.
